caseName: St. Louis Union Trust Co. v. Mellen
caseNameFull: St. Louis Union Trust Company v. Mary E. Mellen
attorneys: Mr. W. F. Wilson and Mr. Enoch A. Chase for the petitioner. Mr. J. H. Everest and Mr. R. M. Campbell for the respondents.

opinions.text: Ordered that the order entered herein on December 20, 1915, denying the petition for writ of certiorari, be vacated and set aside and the petition for writ of certiorari granted.
